scenario_label: Illustrative 6-day workweek only; original P6 template durations, not approved site dates

core_checks.title: Check current approved scope and drawing revision
core_checks.help: Record approved drawing/scope reference and any unresolved changes.

core_checks.title: Confirm predecessor work and outstanding holds
core_checks.help: Verify necessary prior inspection, access and engineering release.

core_checks.title: Brief responsible crew and confirm work method
core_checks.help: Record supervisor, team, work area, work method and safe access.

core_checks.title: Confirm materials, tools and equipment are available
core_checks.help: Check actual quantities and equipment against approved plan.

core_checks.title: Report activity-specific field execution and quantities
core_checks.help: Enter observed location, grid, quantities and supporting reference.

core_checks.title: Complete quality/safety checks and evidence references
core_checks.help: Site-report completion alone cannot certify acceptance or safety.

core_checks.title: Record handoff, defects and authorized disposition
core_checks.help: Handover requires the appropriate responsible person's acceptance.

1000.title: Planning and roles
checks: Confirm responsible site and management contacts
Confirm project-specific construction milestones and records register

2000.title: Design and drawings
checks: Identify effective drawing revision and interfaces
Record consultant clarification and revisions required

3000.title: Regulatory controls
checks: Verify statutory submissions and actual permit document
Track authority review, conditions and approved status

4000.title: Site readiness
checks: Confirm site limits, benchmark and setting-out evidence
Check excavation boundaries, access, utilities and safety readiness

5000.title: Substructure
checks: Identify footing or foundation grid and inspection requirements
Record concrete/rebar/formwork evidence and engineering hold clearance

6000.title: Superstructure
checks: Identify level, member and structural drawing reference
Record reinforcement/formwork checks before authorized pour

7000.title: Envelope
checks: Locate elevation and weatherproofing interface
Track mock-up, substrate acceptance and water ingress checks

8000.title: MEP
checks: Identify service route and structural clashes
Confirm required pre-closure inspections, tests and as-built evidence

9000.title: Interior fit-out
checks: Verify room/finish schedules and preceding wet-work
Track setting-out, substrate conditions and finish quality

10000.title: Commissioning and handover
checks: Collect test certificates, punch list and closeout references
Confirm training, handover documents and signed acceptance
